name: wal_writer_delay
description: Time interval between WAL writer flush cycles; controls how often the WAL writer attempts to write pending WAL data to the OS buffer.
symptoms: Higher replication lag under bursty write loads
Unnecessary I/O pressure from overly frequent flush attempts
tuning_tips: Increase this value (e.g., 500–1000 ms) to reduce WAL writer wakeups and I/O overhead on high-throughput systems; decrease only if low-latency WAL persistence is critical and hardware supports it.
